platform_claims_checked.claim: A worktree gives you one working directory per session, shared Git history, independent working trees.
If two sessions open the same working directory, the later write wins and the earlier session's scrollback goes stale.
`git worktree add -b feature-x ../my-repo-feature-x` / `git worktree add ../my-repo-feature-x feature-x` / `git worktree remove ../repo-bug-fix`
`git stash push -m "..."` in one worktree, `git stash pop` in another moves work across worktrees via shared Git history.
`git reset --soft HEAD~1` un-commits the last commit while keeping changes staged.
